currentFindings.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reconcile pause receipts on ordinary server reads**

When another device resumes tracking, this device's successful `getFoodTrackingPause()` refresh in `ResumeTrackingPrompt` never calls this receipt reconciler; only queued-control replay does. A previously stored `food-tracking-pause.start` receipt therefore survives even after the client observes an inactive server pause, and if connectivity is later lost before a particular day is fetched, `queuedFoodDayStatus` projects that stale receipt as `PAUSED` and blocks offline food logging for that day. Record fresh ordinary pause-query snapshots through this function under the namespace lock as well.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
